alexandria.name: Alexandria
alexandria.title: Whole Home Renovation in White Oak and Brass
alexandria.description: A whole home carried by white oak cabinetry, a marble kitchen island under black cone pendants, and a sage laundry over checkerboard tile, by Jennifer Kizzee Design.
alexandria.keyword: whole home renovation white oak cabinetry
alexandria.rooms: Kitchen, Living room, Laundry, Powder room, Pantry
alexandria.materials: White oak, brass, marble, checkerboard tile
copy: We took this house room by room and let white oak carry the millwork through it. The kitchen runs a marble island under black cone pendants hung from a brass frame, with a brass-strapped hood over the range and a full wall of oak pantry doors beside it.

The smaller rooms hold the color. The laundry is sage green over a checkerboard floor, the powder room pairs a checked paper with a gilt mirror, and the living room sits against a stone fireplace under exposed beams.

ambrose-kitchen.name: Ambrose Kitchen
ambrose-kitchen.title: White Kitchen with a White Oak Island
ambrose-kitchen.description: A white kitchen with a white oak island, a gray herringbone backsplash and black and brass lantern pendants, by Houston interior designer Jennifer Kizzee.
ambrose-kitchen.keyword: white kitchen white oak island herringbone backsplash
ambrose-kitchen.materials: White oak, quartz, herringbone tile, brass
copy: The room stayed white and the island changed everything. We built it in white oak with a veined quartz top, then ran a gray herringbone tile from the counters to the hood so the backsplash reads as one surface rather than a band.
Lantern pendants in black and brass hang over the island, and the same brass returns on the cabinet pulls. Open oak shelves sit beside the range for the pieces that get used every day.

copy: The hood is the whole room. We had it made in black steel and banded it in brass, then set black glass front cabinets on either side so the wall reads as one composition under the vaulted ceiling.
Everything else stays quiet. White cabinetry, a long quartz island with seating for five, white subway tile, and faceted pendants that pick up the brass without competing with it.
